test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B can do a piece of work in 13 days and 52 days, respectively. Both work for 2 days and then A goes away. How long (in days) will B take to complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

A alone = 13 days

B alone = 52 days

Calculations:

Total work = LCM(13,52) = 52 units

⇒ A's efficiency = 52 ÷ 13 = 4 units/day

⇒ B's efficiency = 52 ÷ 52 = 1 unit/day

⇒ (A + B) per day = 4 × 1 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 5 × 2 = 10 units

⇒ Remaining work = 52 − 10 = 42 units

⇒ B alone takes = 42 ÷ 1 = 42 days

**∴ B will take 42 days to complete the remaining work.**
